title: ProntoPC Pod Contract
description: ProntoPC's own Pod DESIGN. The POD Architecture is general; a DataQuad-for-a-CyberPeer requires PEER/PCT/NCT/SPINE tensors, steward/advocate roles and a temporal daemon - a PC-repair product does not. ProntoPC's specific requirements are declared here: a thin orchestration core that owns nothing but phase sequencing, plus Orbs (inside) and Portals (outward), each attached by an Umbilical. Attach, don't affect: adding or removing a capability never edits the Pod core.

orchestrator.description: ProntoPC's equivalent of the Pod processor: the thin shell that sequences the phases (scan -> plan -> consent -> repair -> verify -> complete) by invoking attached Orbs across their Umbilicals. It owns orchestration state only - never diagnostic or repair logic.

portals.description: Orbs whose defining function crosses OUTWARD to a service the Pod does not own (Stripe, LLM providers, Cloud Run, the asset pipeline). Same attachment shape; outward-facing.

model.description: The Educated Model at the orchestrating center of the POD (docs/POD_ARCHITECTURE.md sec1). Honest provenance - what SHIPS vs. what is research-only. The Canon is the model's formed disposition (intrinsic, education-time); the Nature Layer is runtime-supplied, not educated in.

architecture.description: The two-Orb POD architecture (docs/POD_ARCHITECTURE.md, TOTEM-C-0113): the Model is the orchestrating center; Orbs & Satellites give it its abilities. This block is the authoritative mapping of the flat orbs[] list onto the two product Orbs and the append-only relay seam that joins them.

manifest_specs.description: The Manifest-of-Completion spec IDs whose PASS (with Auditor evidence) promotes this attachment to verified. This is the trust gate: an Orb is verified only when its specs pass.

role.description: Architecture-level grouping (docs/POD_ARCHITECTURE.md): which product Orb this component belongs to — 'computer-technician', 'communications-governance', 'infrastructure', or 'capability'.

client_channel.description: Whether this component has a direct customer channel. The Computer Technician Orb has none; only the Communications & Governance Orb is the front door.

relay.description: Role on the append-only Technician->Communications findings relay seam (TOTEM-C-0112).

composed_of.description: For an architecture-level Orb attachment, the component orb_ids that give it its function.
